description:
Get a specific chart leaderboard by slug (e.g. 'top-rated', 'trending', 'top-rated-brand-chanel'). Returns ranked fragrances with scores and movement.

See also: `charts_list` to see all available charts · `fragrance_get` for the full profile of any fragrance on the chart.
